tci_shacker.text: Conch salad: raw conch, lime, onion, pepper, tomato. It's chopped to order, in front of you. If it's not still wriggling, it's not fresh.
A conch has a pink shell and a very serious attitude. It's a sea snail. A big one.

tci_eater.text: I've had conch salad, fritters and chowder. I've had a conch every way. I can't look it in the eye.
Ask me about the closed season. It's a good rule. Conch were running out.
